# My Baking Creations

> Family-owned Bay Area bakery specializing in custom cakes, cookies, cake pops, and cupcakes. Founded 2012. Trusted by Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Fortune 500 companies.

## Business Info
- Name: My Baking Creations
- Location: 1096 Wildwood Ave, Daly City, CA 94015
- Phone: (415) 568-8060
- Email: info@mybakingcreations.com
- Website: https://mybakingcreations.com
- Hours: Monday-Saturday, 9am-6pm
- Founded: 2012
- Owner: Yana

## Service Area
San Francisco, Daly City, San Jose, Palo Alto, Mountain View, San Rafael, and the greater Bay Area / Silicon Valley.

## Products & Pricing
- Custom Cakes: $250-$650+ (birthday, wedding, sculpted 3D, ultra-realistic, milestone)
- Custom Cookies: $5-$8 each (logo cookies, hand-piped royal icing, printed image)
- Cake Pops: $5-$10 each (branded, custom colors, corporate events)
- Cupcakes: $5-$8 each (decorated, themed, corporate)

## Corporate Services
We specialize in corporate orders for tech companies and Fortune 500 clients. Services include:
- Logo cookies for client gifts and employee appreciation
- Branded cake pops for trade shows, product launches, conferences
- Custom celebration cakes for company milestones
- Corporate event dessert packages

Notable corporate clients: Google, Meta, Microsoft, Salesforce, DocuSign, OpenAI, Instagram, PayPal, Gap, Alaska Airlines, Golden State Warriors, Twitch, Cooley LLP, Stripe, Levi's, Kaiser Permanente.

- Email: info@mybakingcreations.com

Typical lead time: 2-3 weeks for custom orders. Rush orders may be available.
